text: Create a feature flag in the Admin UI and connect it to your application by integrating an SDK
quote: Create your first feature flag using the Unleash Admin UI. Connect Unleash to your application by integrating an SDK into your codebase.

text: Gradual rollouts release a new feature to a small subset of users first
quote: A **gradual rollout** is a controlled release strategy where a new feature is first released to a small subset of users.

text: Combine activation strategies, such as a 75% rollout plus guaranteed access for internal users
quote: to roll out a feature to 75% of users while granting access to internal users, you can add two activation strategies

text: Release a feature at a specific date and time using a date-based currentTime constraint
quote: Add a date-based constraint by selecting the `currentTime` context field (step 1 in the below image), choosing the `DATE_AFTER` operator

text: Schedule feature releases or make features available only for a limited time
quote: You can also use them to schedule feature releases or make features available for a limited time.

text: Group change requests and apply them at a scheduled point in time
quote: Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.

text: Self-host Unleash Open Source or Enterprise in your own environment with Docker
quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.

text: Run Unleash in the vendor's cloud or self-host it on your own infrastructure
quote: Run it in our cloud or self-host it on your infrastructure.

text: Hosted cloud instance provides a ready-to-use environment with no local setup
quote: This gives you a ready-to-use instance, so you can explore all Unleash features without any local setup.

text: Edge acts as a read replica that serves thousands of SDKs without adding read load to the primary instance
quote: functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance

text: Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer that improves scalability, performance, and resilience
quote: Unleash Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer designed to improve scalability, performance, and resilience.

text: Edge survives restarts and keeps working if the connection to the Unleash server is lost
quote: Edge is designed to survive restarts and maintain functionality even if you lose connection to your Unleash server.

text: Targeting PII is processed inside the Edge node and never sent to Unleash Cloud or the upstream instance
quote: user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance

text: Admin API gives programmatic access to flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations
quote: The Admin API provides full programmatic access to manage all resources within Unleash, including feature flags, projects, environments, users, and integrations.

text: The Admin API powers the Admin UI itself and supports automation workflows
quote: This API powers the Unleash Admin UI and enables automation workflows.

text: An MCP server lets LLM coding assistants create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices
quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.

text: Variants expose different versions of a feature to users for A/B and multivariate testing
quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.

text: Segments are reusable sets of strategy constraints that you define once and apply across many flags and release templates
quote: Instead of repeating the same rules in multiple places, you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags or [release templates](/concepts/release-templates).

text: Supports custom activation strategies and targeting
quote: Custom activation strategies and targeting

text: Each environment keeps its own flag configuration, so a flag can be on in dev/test but off in production
quote: each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.

text: Change requests require an extra approval step before changes are made in an environment
quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.

text: Up to 10 approvals can be required for a change request
quote: You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.

text: Role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles
quote: Unleash implements role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles for precise permission management.

text: Enterprise users can create custom root roles and custom project roles
quote: Enterprise users can create their own custom root roles and custom project roles.

text: Backend API tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment
quote: Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.

text: API keys handle communication for SDKs, Unleash Edge, and other tools and automation
quote: Unleash uses API keys to facilitate communication between consuming clients such as SDKs, Unleash Edge, or other tools and automation.

text: Frontend tokens are not secret and are safe to expose client-side
quote: Frontend tokens are not considered secret and are safe to expose client-side.

text: Release templates are predefined rollout sequences that can be applied to any feature flag
quote: Release templates: Predefined rollout sequences that you can apply to any feature flag.

text: Reusable, structured rollout process that advances automatically while monitoring application health
quote: you can define a reusable, structured rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health

text: Rollout milestones advance (e.g., 25% to 50%) only if error rates stay below a threshold
quote: Progress from 25% to 50% only if error rates stay below a threshold.

text: Safeguards pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold
quote: Automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold.

text: Rollouts pause automatically when request latency rises
quote: Pause automatically when request latency increases during a rollout.

text: External metrics are queried at read time from your own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics, and the data stays in your system
quote: External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. The data stays in your system.

text: Release, experiment on, and kill features in real time without redeploying
quote: Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.

text: Enable and disable features for specific users without redeploying the application
quote: They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.

text: Over 30 SDKs cover all major programming languages
quote: With over 30 SDKs, we enable fast and secure feature flagging across all major programming languages.

text: 15 official client and server SDKs plus over 15 community SDKs
quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.

text: You can build your own custom SDK
quote: You can even create your own SDK if you wish.

text: Export and import feature flags for migration
quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration

text: A dedicated dashboard tracks stale feature flags
quote: Track stale feature flags with a dedicated dashboard

text: Integrations with GitHub, Slack, and CI/CD pipelines
quote: Integrate with popular tools like GitHub, Slack, CI/CD pipelines.

text: Single sign-on via SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect (Azure AD, Okta)
quote: Single Sign-On (SSO) with SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect (Azure AD, Okta)

text: Hosted instance includes unlimited projects and environments, SSO, and SCIM provisioning
quote: This gives you access to a hosted instance with unlimited projects and environments and features such as role-based access control, change requests, single sign-on, and SCIM

text: Debug targeting to see why a user does or does not get a flag
quote: **Debug targeting**: Check why a user gets or doesn't get a flag.

text: Teams can work on multiple features at once without separate feature branches
quote: It also enables your team to work on multiple features simultaneously without the need for separate feature branches.

text: Test code against real production data with feature flags to reduce user impact
quote: Feature flags in Unleash let you test your code with real production data, reducing the risk of negatively impacting your users' experience.
